rationale: WYHG gapped up ~36% with no identifiable news catalyst, which creates ambiguity about whether this is a sustained move or a pump-and-fade; the price is currently below the 5-minute VWAP ($5.32) and decelerating volume (24k → 7.4k over the last five candles) hints at exhaustion, but the wide 56.8 bps spread combined with unknown borrow availability makes a short difficult to execute cleanly, and the 9-EMA ($5.25) is providing nearby support that weakens a short thesis. With no comparable historical setups, no news anchor, and structural ambiguity in both directions, the risk-adjusted edge is insufficient to justify capital allocation.
